admission.justification: Realized across standalone_pr_landing.py and finalize.py::_readiness, proved by test_finalize_refusals_for_missing_unlanded_and_abandoned_standalone_master, and required to keep standalone PR finalization safe without closeout cells.

applicability: lifecycle_finalize_task readiness evaluation for a pull-request-landed standalone master matching Rule 1.
conditions: closeout_status == 'completed' and non-empty code_commit are not required.
master-abandoned blocks when the master task document or contract.cleanup reads abandoned.
landed-commit-missing blocks when integrated_code_commit is empty or, for external memory, integrated_memory_content_commit is empty or not an ancestor of memory_source_branch.
not-landed-on-target-branch blocks when integrated_code_commit is not an ancestor of code_source_branch.
memory-carryover-incomplete blocks when carryover_done(contract) is false.
exclusions: Squash-merged landings where commit ancestry cannot prove the work branch tip on the target branch.
Contracts outside the PR-landed standalone master class, which retain closeout-not-complete and code-commit-missing readiness checks.
statement: Finalize readiness for a pull-request-landed standalone master does not require closeout_status == 'completed' or code_commit, refuses missing integrated_code_commit or missing/unreachable external integrated_memory_content_commit with landed-commit-missing, refuses integrated_code_commit not an ancestor of code_source_branch with not-landed-on-target-branch, refuses an abandoned master document or contract cleanup with master-abandoned, and keeps memory-carryover-incomplete.
title: Finalize readiness blockers for PR-landed standalone masters
